Four modern martyrs: Remembering Maura, Ita, Dorothy and Jean: A Scattering of Seeds and Words of Gratitude

I was lying on the floor holding onto someone I love and I had an old memory of you being vulnerable and tender flash in my mind's eye. A memory... When your voice would go sweet. When tears would fill your eyes because you had too much love and didn't know how to express it. You showed me soft parts of you and I didn't appreciate them. I continued for four years loving you, treasuring our companionship, but not knowing that I was causing your heart to callous over the way my fingertips do because I play so much damn guitar.

When you showed me your vulnerabilities I shut them out. I didn't acknowledge what YOU were going through. I didn't know how to put myself in your shoes, to know what it was like to have THAT much love. I took it for granted, I took you for granted, and I took your tenderness for granted.

When you showed me your heart I made you feel like you were showing me nothing, until you had no heart left to show. I didn't appreciate you. I didn't appreciate our love...

..But I do now.

It is a sacred place, and I am eternally grateful for what I learned from our relationship. When I love people now, when people give me the honor to hold them close to me the way you did, I treasure it and I don't take it for granted.

I don't usually sleep alone, but when I do it is a beautiful thing and I find myself in my own solitude.

When I am blessed to have someone there to hold I think fondly of you and within that moment can appreciate everyone and everything in my life. Near the end of our relationship you wouldn't let me hold you anymore and that is a reflection on myself and the coldness that I developed towards you over our years together. After we split I found many people to share my love with and many beautiful people to hold. Sometimes there's a few of us cuddled up together, sometimes just two of us, no matter who is there, if they chose to share that moment with me I won't take it for granted. I will hold onto them like I never want to let go, and the only thing that will get me out of bed are my adult responsibilities. I could just lay there forever, holding onto that touch, holding onto that moment.

You taught me how to treasure these experiences and to not take the people I hold, or the people I love, for granted.

I am sorry that my heart wasn't open when yours was, but I am thankful it is open now and I am thankful that I can finally give the love that the people in my life need when they need it... and I am thankful they are there to give me love too, when I need it, because I do.

I won't take this for granted. I won't let what happened to us happen to me.

tl;dr - Did some lsd last night, had a flashback memory right before I fell asleep, rambled about love on the internet the next day. I am thankful for everything, for all my love, and all my loves.
